subject: CareCore DPA: no-train / evidence playbook & next steps
messages:
From: Luke Turner <dpa-legal@carecorehealth.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Cc: Sonia Patel <procurement@carecorehealth.com>
Date: 2027-10-25T09:42:00-07:00
Subject: DPA updates — request for no-train commitment and evidence

Hi Marissa,

Thanks for the draft DPA. Our legal team flagged a few items we need clarified before we can finalize:

- A firm "no-training" / "no model improvement" commitment for customer-provided content (we need precise scope and operational proof).
- Evidence that prompt/response pairs are not used for model updates outside the customer tenant (subprocessor list and residency assurances).
- Subprocessor attestation for downstream vendors (we're especially concerned about third-party analytics and metrics providers).
- Cross-border transfer exposure and whether KMS / key residency can be restricted to the US.

Can you send us: (1) a short operational checklist showing how Redwood enforces no-training in practice, (2) a current subprocessor inventory with attestations, and (3) proposed contract language we can circulate internally?

We have a procurement deadline of Nov 10 and would like to get legal sign-off earlier if possible. If we need an escalation, please indicate who we should speak to on your side.

Regards,
Luke Turner
Senior Counsel, Data Privacy
CareCore Health

Attachment: (none in this message)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Luke Turner <dpa-legal@carecorehealth.com>
Cc: Sonia Patel <procurement@carecorehealth.com>, David Kim <david@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-10-25T11:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: DPA updates — request for no-train commitment and evidence

Hi Luke / Sonia,

Appreciate the clear list — we can move quickly on this. High-level answers first, then I attached our proposed redline and evidence artifacts.

Quick answers:
- No-training commitment: Redwood will commit that CareCore tenant data is not used to train or improve models outside of an explicitly agreed commercial program (we can include a no-adaptive-training clause and an operational exemption process).
- Operational proof: see the attached "REDWOOD_NoLearn_OpChecklist.xlsx" — it outlines request routing, KV cache isolation, and audit artifacts we pull for attestations.
- Subprocessors: we include a current inventory and a template attestation we can ask each subprocessor to sign.
- KMS/key residency: we offer onshore KMS options for Dedicated and Private customers; for Hosted customers we can provide customer-managed keys for a number of regions — Karthik will map options to your account's chosen deployment.

Attached: CareCore_DPA_Redline_v1.pdf (redline with language proposals), REDWOOD_NoLearn_OpChecklist.xlsx, Subprocessor_Attestation_Template.docx

Next steps I propose:
1) Quick 30-minute call this week to walk through the operational checklist and confirm anything missing.
2) We update the redline based on that call and return a revised DPA for your internal review.
3) If your legal requires VP-level signoff on the no-train commitment, we can loop in Jonas Weber (Head of Legal) — he is available for a call next week.

Would 2pm PT on Wednesday (Oct 27) work for a call?

Best,
Marissa Cole
Senior Director, Sales
Redwood Inference

Attachments: CareCore_DPA_Redline_v1.pdf (pdf), REDWOOD_NoLearn_OpChecklist.xlsx (xlsx), Subprocessor_Attestation_Template.docx (docx)

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
To: Ops Security <ops-security@redwood.com>, David Kim <david@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-10-26T14:20:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: CareCore DPA — specifics for ops / subprocessor mapping

Forwarding Luke's ask to ops/security and privacy — see inbound. Technical notes for the call:

- Isolation model: CareCore will be on a dedicated tenant with per-tenant KV cache isolation. We will document the request flow and the token-lifetime policies used to prevent capture into any model training pipelines.
- Audit evidence: we can produce a daily export of request IDs, associated tenant IDs, and the KV eviction logs for the window the customer requests. Full export can be delivered to an SFTP you control for retention.
- Subprocessors: current list: (a) Cloud infra (AWS us-east-1), (b) Metrics (PulseAnalytics), (c) Vector DB (VectoStore), (d) Model runtime partners (for deduplication and kernels). We will prepare attestations for (b)-(d).
- KMS: we support customer-managed keys via external KMS providers; for onshore requirement we'll show a proof path and an MOU for key residency.

Ops/security: please pull the small evidence packet (audit example JSONs, SFTP export spec) and drop into the drive folder prior to the Wed call. I'll be on the call to answer runtime and routing questions.

-Karthik

Date: 2027-10-28T08:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: DPA updates — request for no-train commitment and evidence

Hi Marissa / team,

Thanks — a few clarifying asks from procurement and security:

1) The operational checklist looks promising, but we need a short (1-2 page) "No-Learn Operational Summary" that we can attach to our DPA appendix for our auditors. Can Redwood provide a concise single-page summary version?

2) Attestation timing: we need subprocessor attestations within two weeks of DPA signing. Is that feasible? If not, we need milestones.

3) For the KMS option: please confirm if customer-managed keys are available on the hosted plan or if this requires Dedicated/Private. If hosted requires Dedicated, call that out explicitly.

Finally, if there's any residual risk that requires escalation (e.g., vendor that refuses attestation), who in Redwood is the escalation contact for procurement?

We can do the Wed 2pm PT call but would prefer to include a security engineer — can you send a calendar invite with a link to the evidence folder?

Regards,
Sonia Patel
Procurement Manager
CareCore Health

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Sonia Patel <procurement@carecorehealth.com>, Luke Turner <dpa-legal@carecorehealth.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>, David Kim <david@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-10-28T11:12:00-07:00
Subject: Re: DPA updates — request for no-train commitment and evidence

Sonia — thanks, good points. Quick responses and actions:

1) Single-page summary: we will produce a 1-page "No-Learn Operational Summary" and place it in the shared drive. I'll attach a draft to the invite.
2) Attestation timing: we will target "attestation collection within 14 days of signature" as requested. For subprocessors that require more time we will provide milestone commitments (we've seen 21-30 day timelines for a small subset).
3) KMS: customer-managed keys on Hosted are supported for crypto at-rest for select regions, but full dedicated on-prem KMS residency for encryption of model state requires Dedicated/Private. We'll mark that clearly in the summary.

Escalation: Jonas Weber (cc'd) will be the contractual escalation lead for any unresolved subprocessor refusal or material compliance gaps. David Kim (cc'd) will supply the privacy attestation artifacts. Karthik will join to answer technical questions on the call.

I've set the call for Wed Oct 27 at 2pm PT — updating to Wed Oct 28 at 2pm PT to match availability and included a security engineer invitee. Calendar invite and drive folder link below.

Hi all —

Thanks for the productive discussion this morning. Per the call, attaching the initial Ops Playbook and the one-page No-Learn summary. Summary of commitments we agreed on:

- Contract language: Redwood will include a no-adaptive-training clause scoped to CareCore tenant interactions; exceptions require a separate MOU.
- Evidence deliverables: initial attestation pack and audit samples delivered to the shared drive by EOD Nov 3.
- Subprocessors: attestations targeted within 14 days post-signature; for any vendor missing attestation we will provide a mitigation plan and interim controls.
- KMS: Hosted with customer-managed keys is available for select regions; Dedicated required for full onshore KMS residency.

Assigned owners:
- Marissa: updated DPA redline (v2) and one-page summary (Marissa) — due Nov 3.
- David: privacy attestation artifacts and evidence examples — due Nov 3.
- Karthik: SFTP export spec and audit payload sample — due Nov 3.
- Jonas: escalation point for contractual sign-off and any exceptions.

Attachments in drive (also attached here): Ops_Playbook_v1.pdf, REDWOOD_NoLearn_OpChecklist.xlsx, NoLearn_Summary_1page.pdf

If anything changes on your side, please flag immediately — we know your timeline is tight and we'll prioritize the delivery.

Best,
Marissa Cole
